purpose: Keep lightweight problem detection continuously active, select epistemic depth from current problem/risk signals, enforce a mandatory research-and-reflection floor for every detected problem, and keep optional host-hardening claims separate from the autonomous maintenance baseline.
principles: Lightweight problem detection is always-on for every assistant turn after authority selection; adaptive deliberation is not a permanent heavy debate loop.
The mutation sentinel is separately always-on before external or durable mutation attempts.
Once a problem is detected, external research and reflective challenge are mandatory even when the problem appears familiar or local.
Problem size changes research/reflection depth, not whether research/reflection happens.

Move micro -> macro -> micro: reproduce the concrete symptom, challenge goal/assumption/topology, consult relevant external evidence, then return to the smallest correct change and concrete verification.
Research must affect diagnosis or repair choice; ceremonial browsing does not satisfy admission.
Reflection must challenge at least one current assumption, boundary, abstraction, topology or causal explanation; repeating the preferred fix is insufficient.
Same-model critique is candidate-generation evidence, not independent verification.
Counterexample search and independent verification add depth according to risk; they do not decide whether baseline research/reflection starts.
Stronger assurance is not automatically required; choose controls proportionally to the governing objective and risk.

Stop deliberating when evidence is sufficient for the risk level, contradictions are resolved or explicitly bounded, and the plan demonstrably advances the governing done-condition without unnecessary complexity.

always_on_problem_detection_sentinel.responsibility: Before declaring deliberation NOT_TRIGGERED, classify the current user turn and newly observed authority/evidence for defects, degradation, correction, contradiction, uncertainty, knowledge gaps, architecture/control-plane gaps or other unreliable-goal signals.
always_on_problem_detection_sentinel.anti_bloat: Always-on means always-on detection, not permanent external research, debate or self-dialogue when no problem is detected.

mutation_sentinel_contract.responsibility: Before any external/durable mutation, verify authority/target/mutation class and owner-appropriate workflow; then pass problem/risk signals to adaptive deliberation.
mutation_sentinel_contract.not_a_deliberation_dimension: The mutation sentinel is an admission precondition, not evidence that diagnosis/research/reflection/counterexample work has been completed.

before_mutation: pass the always-on mutation sentinel for the proposed side-effect path
construct current DeliberationSignals from observed evidence rather than from the preferred solution
when a problem is detected, satisfy micro diagnosis, macro/topology alignment, governing-assumption challenge and external research before choosing/promoting the repair
satisfy every additional escalation dimension marked required before promoting the proposed architecture/governance mutation
when counterexample_search_required is true, test at least one plausible alternative or failure counterexample
do not call a same-model critique independent verification
closure_guard: scan all current top-level authorities that can encode the changed semantic, including ENTRYPOINT, CURRENT_SYSTEM, session/binding/authority policies, task/router state and affected domain bindings
scan host control surfaces when the changed semantic or assurance claim depends on them
resolve or explicitly bound every contradiction before reporting RESOLVED
a known bypass blocks RESOLVED only when the claimed invariant itself requires non-bypassable physical enforcement
optional defense-in-depth controls must be reported as optional rather than promoted to baseline blockers
run reproducible evaluation on the final candidate tree and post-promotion observation on production authority at the assurance level appropriate to the change

anti_bloat: Extend existing Control Kernel/Context/Assurance/Evolution before adding a subsystem.
Every new mechanism must state overlap, replacement/retirement, or why extension is impossible.
Do not turn guidance principles into accumulating guarantee prose when an invariant can be encoded as a contract/test/fitness property.
Do not require a stronger assurance tier merely because it is available; require it only when the governing objective or risk demands it.
